# Forgive Seventy Times Seven (Matthew 18:22)

## Emotional Focus
Forgiving again and again like Jesus does.

## Key KJV
“Until seventy times seven.” (Matthew 18:22)

## Gentle Retelling
Peter asked how many times he should forgive. Jesus said not just seven times but seventy times seven — which means always. Jesus forgives us every single time.

## Coloring Prompt
Two children hugging after saying sorry; Jesus watching with a kind smile.

## Read-along flow + response
“Jesus helps us forgive, just like He forgives us.”
